Coram : S.B. SINHA*, P.P. NAOLEKAR
OF CHHATTISGARH v. LEKHRAM APRIL 5, 2006 B [S.B. SINHA AND P.P. NAOLEKAR, JJ.) Penal Code, 1860; Ss. 366 and 376/Jndian Evidence Act; S. 35: Abduction and rape of a minor married woman by the accused-Age C of prosecutrix-Proof of-Entry in the School register-Admissibility in evidence-Held: A has evidentiary value­ Since entries in the register and statement of father of the prosecutrix D corroborated by other witnesses, there was no reason for disbelieving the same by the.High Court-Hence, !he judgment of the High Court convicting the accused by reversing the order of the trial
